verdict.rationale: LobeHub lets users drive key product actions in natural language. A single sentence sets up an agent's name, role, skills and behaviors (lobe-chat-docs-43). The system assembles agent teams for a described task (lobe-chat-docs-17), and onboarding turns what you say about your work into starter Tasks (lobe-chat-docs-2, lobe-chat-docs-46), all from a home composer (lobe-chat-docs-1). Missing for 10: evidence that general product operations (settings, navigation, workspace or project management) can be done by natural-language command, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the one-sentence setup flow.
